items.item: Frozen pairs specify prose relations, not an executable candidate pair scorer. Post-reveal runner operationalizes those relations explicitly.
items.impact: Nine relation checks hold. Supplemental strict_pair_pass also requires exact endpoint controls; zero of nine satisfy that conjunction. It does not replace or weaken frozen per-case scoring.
